title: ChangeEventOutputContract
description: Output schema produced by Member 3 (Change Detection Engineer) and consumed by Member 4 (Backend API Service) adhering strictly to SIH 2026 PS 26227.

change_mask.description: Path, URI, or reference to the generated COG GeoTIFF containing uint8 change mask (0=no-change, 1=change).

change_type.description: Semantic categorization of the dominant detected change.

change_morphology.description: Morphological pattern describing how the spatial feature transformed.

confidence.description: Calibrated change detection confidence score following false-alarm suppression.

earliest_supported_date.description: Earliest confirmed acquisition timestamp (ISO 8601) in a multi-temporal stack where change emerged, or null if single-pair.

bbox_wgs84.description: Bounding box in WGS84 coordinates [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

stac_change_event.description: STAC Item JSON representation adhering to contracts/stac_change_event.schema.json.

provenance.description: Cryptographic, algorithmic, and operational metadata for auditable forensic traceability.

weights_sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of model weights used during inference.

code_git_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the running codebase or fallback version identifier.

sar_fused.description: True if Sentinel-1 SAR VV/VH fusion was performed.

suppression_stages_fired.description: Ordered record of false-alarm suppression filters triggered.

registration_offset_px.description: Sub-pixel phase-correlation registration offset [dx, dy] in pixels.

inference_latency_ms.description: Inference and suppression processing duration in milliseconds.

debug.description: Intermediate metric telemetry for troubleshooting and calibration.
